description: The bar chart illustrates the performance gain, measured in percentage, of three different language models (GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and Qwen2-72B-VL) under two different supervision conditions: strong and weak. The vertical axis represents the performance gain, with a scale ranging from 0 to 30 percent. The horizontal axis lists the three language models. For each model, there are two bars representing the performance gain under strong and weak supervision. The bar for strong supervision is filled with diagonal stripes, while the bar for weak supervision is filled with a solid color. The GPT-4o model shows the highest performance gain under strong supervision, with a value close to 30 percent, and a lower value under weak supervision, around 5 percent. Claude-3.5-Sonnet has a performance gain of approximately 10 percent under strong supervision and around 5 percent under weak supervision. Qwen2-72B-VL shows a performance gain of about 15 percent under strong supervision and around 5 percent under weak supervision. The chart does not indicate any specific sorting or emphasis on the bars.
